claims: The Philadelphia 76ers defeated the Orlando Magic 109-97 on Tuesday.
The Philadelphia 76ers secured the East's No. 7 seed.
The Golden State Warriors are the 9th-place team in the Western Conference.
The LA Clippers are the 10th-place team in the Western Conference.
The No. 9 Golden State Warriors visit the No. 10 LA Clippers at 10:00 PM ET on Prime Video.
The winner of the No. 9 Golden State Warriors at No. 10 LA Clippers game plays the Phoenix Suns on Friday.
The NBA Play-In Tournament continues with Western Conference action on Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
